Independent sub-agent review requested by owner: one confirmed P2 finding. Fully censored run 2 in the existing corrected GLS fixture causes corrected voxelwise AR(1) to throw IndexOutOfBoundsException in Gls diagnostics and shared/run-pooled AR(2) to throw IllegalArgumentException at ArDiagnostics' common-order coefficient invariant. Reproduced on JVM and Scala.js: two tests per target, two failures each. The native estimator emits an IID empty coefficient vector with NotAttempted; diagnostics do not normalize that valid filter to their common AR order. Recommended fix: normalize diagnostic IID vectors without changing native whitening/outcomes; add both pooling modes plus bounded execution to the fully-censored regression. This pre-existing assumption blocks the advertised corrected consumer contract.

No other actionable findings. Reviewer independently passed all 13 receipt freshness checks and six Python tests; full Scala suites, live R regeneration and hosted CI were not repeated. Implementation source hashes still match the original verification. Probe removed and temporary build settings restored. Implementation untouched; mote remains review pending remediation.

Retained review and reproducer: docs/verification/ar-consumer-closure-20261007/review/review.json (with JVM/JS logs and ArConsumerReviewProbeSuite.scala).
